acceptanceCriteria: protocol/cem-1.0/stable/ALGORITHMS.md states the discrimination witness bound (mutants above maxMutants refused invalid-field at the wire stage; equality admitted; survivors must agree with survived) with CEM-V1-090 cited, so an implementer with the packet alone reproduces the tamper-matrix verdicts
protocol/cem-1.0/stable/tamper-matrix/README.md case count matches EXPECTED.json (23 after V1-1259), and manifest digests are regenerated where the packet pins those files
body: Follow-up from V1-1259 (PR #888, CEM-V1-090). The native and portable consumers now refuse a discrimination witness whose mutants exceed maxMutants, and three tamper-matrix cases were added (EXPECTED.json 23 cases). Codex (one read-only round) flagged, and the lane retained as limits because both files are edited by PR #879 (V1-1333): (1) the 1.0-normative packet ALGORITHMS.md does not name the bound; (2) the tamper-matrix README count reads eighteen (nineteen after #879). Do after both #879 and #888 merge.
title: CEM 1.0 packet: state the discrimination maxMutants bound in ALGORITHMS.md and fix the tamper-matrix README count
